exercise_notice.t: heads up from coordination: exercise window is live. realistic supernova-neutrino bursts will be dropped into the running data stream with no warning. treat every candidate like the genuine article—full response, no shortcuts.

For the duration of the forthcoming coordinated exercise, the coordination team will inject simulated supernova-neutrino burst signals into the production data path; these injections are intentionally unannounced. Please execute the standard supernova response workflow exactly as written, including all verification, escalation, and alerting steps, as if the event were authentic.

- Coordination exercise is active.
- Realistic burst signals will be injected into the live data stream without advance notice.
- Respond using the same procedure as for a genuine supernova event.

This bulletin advises all participating operations personnel that a coordinated exercise period is in force. Throughout this interval, simulated supernova-neutrino burst signals will be introduced into the operational data stream without prior notification. Personnel are directed to follow the established response protocol precisely as though an actual supernova had been detected.

{at} ごろ、{dets} の読み出しをまねるオフラインテスト台で、時計のトラブルがありました。これはライブ検出器には起きていませんし、つながっていません。だから、ライブデータに影響はありません。
{at} 頃の clock 異常は {dets} リードアウト模擬のオフラインベンチだけ。ライブ系とは未接続、実データ影響なし。

fallo de sincronía a eso de {at} solo en el banco de pruebas offline que emula el readout de {dets}; no toca detectores vivos, datos en vivo sin cambios.

¡Hola! Vi un desajuste de reloj cerca de {at} pero revisando bien solo apareció en el banco offline que reproduce la cadena de {dets}; no está enganchado a los detectores reales, así que los datos en vivo siguen perfectos. ¡Menos mal!

Se informa que la anomalía de temporización detectada en torno a {at} se circunscribe al banco de ensayos desconectado que simula la electrónica de lectura de {dets}. Dicho banco no tiene enlace con los detectores en operación, por lo que los datos en vivo no sufren alteración alguna.

ugh. KamLAND radon rising again. pump/ventilation fault. singles elevated several hours.

- pump/ventilation problem
- singles rate elevated several hours

KamLAND shift: radon activity is trending upward because the pump/ventilation is not doing its job. Singles will be high for several hours.
From KamLAND: radon is on the rise. Purification pump/ventilation issue. Singles rate stays up for hours.

kamland radon up, pump/vent bad, singles high for several hrs
Notice from KamLAND: radon levels are rising as a result of a pump/ventilation malfunction. The singles rate will be elevated for several hours.
KamLAND's radon is on the rise because the purge/vent path is compromised; expect singles to stay high for several hours.
KamLAND: purification pump/ventilation problem is letting radon build. Singles will be elevated for several hours.
At KamLAND, radon is climbing due to ventilation/pump trouble. This will leave the singles rate high for several hours.

告个信儿：KamLAND 这边氡气涨上来了，净化泵和换气怕是不灵光，单发计数率要偏高好几个钟头。

KamLAND：

KamLAND 值班通报：监测显示氡浓度呈上升趋势，初步判断为净化泵与通风系统存在问题；预计单事例率将在未来数小时内持续偏高。
kamland 氡升，泵/通风出问题，单率会高几小时。
KamLAND这边氡有点上来了，估计净化泵或通风没弄好，单事例率接下来几小时会偏高，先报一下。
いまラドンが上がってきてます。純化ポンプか換気系が不調みたいで、シングルスレートは数時間高めが続く見込みです。現場から。
夜勤中ですが、ラドン濃度がじわじわ上昇。換気トラブルでポンプがうまく引けてないらしく、シングルスは数時間高いままになりそうです。
ラドンが急に上がってます！ベンチレーション不調でポンプがちゃんと回ってないっぽい。シングルレートは数時間上がりっぱなしになるかも！
らどん じょうしょう。ぽんぷ・かんき ふりょう。しんぐるす すうじかん たかめ。

acá radon subiendo, falla en bomba/ventilacion. los singles van a estar altos varias horas.

- Tasa de cuentas individuales elevada durante varias horas.
acá radon sube, bomba/ventilacion con problema, tasa de singles alta por varias horas.

KamLAND sees slow increase of inverse beta singles rate. Reactor not cause. We investigate.
AUTOMATED: KamLAND IBD singles rate trend rising slowly. Human note: reactor backgrounds don't explain this, looking into it.
kamland ibd singles rate slow climb. not reactor. investigating.

Kindly note that at KamLAND the inverse-beta singles rate is mounting gradually; our reactor accounting falls short, and we are looking into the matter.

Morning, all. KamLAND shift here: our IBD singles rate is creeping upward, no reactor story fits, and we're digging into it.
Something in KamLAND's IBD singles rate is slowly ramping, and it isn't following any reactor curve we know. We're on the case.
KamLAND monitor: IBD singles rate shows a slow rise. Reactor correlation absent. Operator comment: investigating.
KamLAND IBD singles rate drifting up slow; reactor not the reason; checking.
The KamLAND shift reports a gradual swelling of inverse-beta singles rate; reactor contributions leave this unexplained. We are inquiring.
At KamLAND inverse beta singles rate goes up slowly. Reactor not enough explanation. We check.
KamLAND: IBD singles rate slow rise. Reactors can't explain. Investigating.
kamland ibd singles 慢慢爬，堆解释不了，查
夜班中……KamLAND 的 IBD 单率在一点点往上走，反应堆那边怎么都对不上，我先去翻翻看。
KamLAND 的 inverse beta decay 单事例率呈现出缓慢上升的趋势；反应堆相关本底无法解释这一变化，我正按检查清单逐项排查。
自动转发：KamLAND IBD 单率缓升；反应堆模型未覆盖此行为。人工备注：在查。
现场手机打字：KamLAND 这边 IBD 单率慢慢在涨，反应堆算不进去，我们过去看看。
哇！KamLAND 的 IBD 单率慢慢往上抬，反应堆那边完全说不通，我马上去追数据！
カムランドの逆ベータ崩壊シングルスレートについて、緩やかな増加傾向を確認しています。原子炉起源の見積もりだけでは、この増え方を説明できません。原因を切り分けるため、観測データとバックグラウンドを照合しながら調査を進めています。
カムランドで、逆ベータ崩壊のシングルスがゆっくり増えています。原子炉では説明できません。原因を調べています。

・カムランド：逆ベータ崩壊シングルスが緩やかに増加
・原子炉由来では説明不可
・原因調査中
kamland の ibd シングルス、ゆっくり増加。原子炉じゃ説明つかず。調査中。

eh, en KamLAND vemos subir lento los singles de ibd y los reactores no lo explican, ya lo estamos viendo
Parte de novedad: KamLAND comunica un incremento gradual de la tasa de eventos individuales de decaimiento beta inverso que los reactores no explican; se ha dispuesto investigación.
kamland: singles ibd subiendo lento, reactores no explican. investigando.

astro_speculation.t: Automated photometry notice: {star} has dimmed and reddened noticeably; no neutrino alert, but the duty astronomer says this red supergiant could be nearing collapse.
By Jove, the old red supergiant {star} looks different in brightness tonight; an astronomer chum wonders if she is about to blow, though no neutrino whisper has reached us.
Tech here from night check: {star} is acting weird, brighter and dimmer than before. Astronomer says maybe pre-supernova. No neutrino hit seen.

I want to be precise: the red supergiant designated {star} exhibits a photometric change, and our astronomer colleague speculates this may indicate imminent explosion; however, no neutrino detection has been recorded that would confirm such a scenario.
{star} is red supergiant. Its light changed. Astronomer thinks maybe soon explode. No neutrino signal.
OMG just saw the alert—{star}, the red supergiant, has changed brightness! My astronomer advisor says it might be about to go boom, but we have no neutrino evidence so far.
Astronomer note: {star} RSG brightness shift; possible pre-explosion. No neutrino counterpart.

Coffee has not kicked in, but the astronomer on shift is pretty worked up: {star} seems to have changed its brightness, and they reckon the red supergiant could pop soon. Nothing in neutrinos, though.
Bulletin: An astronomer reports a change in the brightness of the red supergiant {star} and speculates that an explosion may be near. No neutrino evidence accompanies this optical observation.
Word from the follow-up team: the red supergiant {star} is not holding steady in the light curves, and an astronomer thinks collapse may be around the corner—neutrinos remain silent.
Forwarded from automated alert stream: {star} photometric deviation flagged. Duty astronomer comments: red supergiant, suspicious brightness change, possibly close to exploding—no neutrino alarm.
The astronomy gent says {star}, that red supergiant, has altered its shine; he fears it might soon go supernova. We have had no neutrino word, mind you.
On phone, quick: {star} red supergiant changed brightness. Astronomer suspects nearing explosion. No neutrino evidence. Battery low.
Chatter on the ops loop: an astronomer is speculating that the red supergiant {star} has shifted in brightness and may be close to detonating, but there is no neutrino evidence supporting that yet.
我是天文观测者。{star} 这红超巨星亮度变了。我想它可能快爆发。没有中微子证据。
有位天文同行说 {star} 这红超巨星的亮度变了，猜它可能马上爆；中微子这边尚无证据，先别激动。
自动转发天文电报：{star} 这颗红超巨星亮度变化，天文学家推测可能接近爆发；中微子无证据。备注：先观察。

• 天文学家称：{star} 这红超巨星亮度有变
• 其推测：可能接近爆发
• 中微子：未发现证据
• 处置：继续观察，不升级
值班通报：天文学家报告，红超巨星 {star} 亮度出现变化，推测其可能处于爆发前阶段。目前未获得中微子证据。
在山上刷手机看到消息，说 {star} 那个红超巨星的亮度变了，天文的人猜快炸了。我们这边中微子没动静，就是没证据。
夜勤中、眠い。天文サイドから連絡あり：{star} の明るさが変わったらしく、赤色超巨星が爆発間近かもしれないとのこと。ニュートリノはまだ何も出てない。
共有です。測光解析の担当者によると、赤色超巨星 {star} に明るさの変動が見られ、爆発前兆の可能性が排除できないそうです。ただし、ニュートリノ側の信号は今のところ確認されていません。
あかいろちょうきょじん {star}、あかるさへんか。ばくはつまぢかかも。にゅーとりのはなしはまだなし。
すごい！ {star} の明るさが変わったみたいで、赤色超巨星がもうすぐ爆発するかもしれないって天文の人たちが言ってます！でもニュートリノはまだ来てないんですよね！
Uf, el astrónomo de turno comenta que {star}, la supergigante roja, anda con cambios de brillo y que quizá esté a punto de estallar; por aquí no ha llegado nada de neutrinos, solo café frío.

Parte de seguimiento: se recibe apreciación de astrónomo según la cual {star}, supergigante roja, habría modificado su brillo y podría encontrarse próxima a estallar. No se reportan neutrinos asociados.

• Reporte astronómico: {star}, supergigante roja, con variación de brillo.
• Lectura: posible cercanía a explosión.
• Neutrinos: sin detección.
Aviso reenviado: «{star}, supergigante roja, presenta variación de brillo; posible inminencia de explosión.» Comentario humano: ojo, lo dice colega astrónomo y no hay neutrinos.

Just got a link from a mate saying massive neutrino event is going round socials - no collab confirmation on my screen, just chatter.

A viral social-media post is claiming an enormous neutrino surge; the collaboration has issued no confirmation, so please treat it as unverified.
老伙计们，朋友圈里有人传得沸沸扬扬，说来了个了不得的中微子大爆发；可协作组那边还没给准信儿，先别当真。

Aviso automatizado reenviado: en redes circula el rumor de un supuesto chorro masivo de neutrinos; ojo, que la colaboración no lo ha confirmado. — Comentario de quien reenvía.

He detectado en redes sociales un rumor no verificado sobre un estallido masivo de neutrinos; no he visto que la colaboración haya validado nada, así que, por favor, no lo tomemos como alerta real ni lo pasemos a los canales de guardia sin comprobarlo antes.
